about: EVERY REPORT HE ALLOWS, AND WHERE (the owner 2026-10-21: a report manifest, locked with the package). One entry a report: name (how a row asks for it: where.report(name)), path (a glob part names many files of one writer; {logs} is his own logs folder below), writer (the program that writes it), every (how often it is written), max_age (hours: older than this, his row 010 is red 'the writer stopped'; null: written only when its writer is started by hand or on a switch, so its age says nothing), transient (true: a lock or a file there only while its writer runs, so its absence is never 'not written'), kind (replaced whole: written over at each run; appended: a log its writer adds lines to). THE REPORT FOLDERS are the parent folders of these paths, and nothing else. Row 010 NEW FILES scrubs them every round: a file not listed here is deleted (one line on the page: what, when); a program, a script, an executable, a link or a hidden file is deleted and the row is red; a listed report older than its max_age is kept and the row is red ('the writer stopped'); a listed report missing makes it red ('not written'). It never works above a report folder, never in ~/virtual_sanity, ~/virtual_workspace or an instance folder, never follows a link (a link is unlinked, its target never touched), skips a folder it cannot write (and says so), and never enters a subfolder that is not itself a report folder (a dated folder of logs is a report folder only through a pattern entry here, e.g. daily/*/*.log). No row names a report's path anywhere but here (settings.json names none).
logs_about: his own logs folder (outside the locked folder): store.log_path writes under it; a check's own: $SCRUM_MASTER_LOGS
